CustomField.description: API name of the field on the target SObject that holds the record's closed/completed status. Its value is compared against the entries in Closed_Status_Values__c to decide whether a record is done. Used in two places: (1) Phase 3 Open Work Item Gate — closed records are excluded so they never count against Max_Capacity__c; (2) WorkItemReaper — completes zombie Agent_Work_Item__c rows whose source record is already closed. Examples: 'Status' for Case / Lead / Task, 'StageName' for Opportunity, 'State__c' or any custom status field on a custom object. Leave blank only if the object has no closure concept — closure-based cleanup will then rely solely on deletion/reassignment detection.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: API name of the field that marks a record closed (e.g. Status, StageName, State__c). Values are matched against Closed_Status_Values__c.
CustomField.label: Closed Status Field API Name
